Dog was sitting in back of kennel, head low, ears back. Handler crouched, called dog, offered treats. Dog slowly came forward, gentle tail wag, accepted treats. Immediately retreated when leash was presented, became tense, lip curled. Dog would cry out and bite at leash when handler attempted to place it; dog would jerk head towards leash to continue biting at it as it was being removed. Handler used sort board as divider, stepped into kennel without presenting leash, used "baby-talk" coaxing, dog softened, approached, licked hand, accepted treats. Continued to be fearful of leash, yelping, baring teeth. Handler was able to lasso large loop after several tries. Dog remained in back of kennel. Handler crouched, called dog, dog slowly came forward, wagged tail, darted past taxi. Handler repositioned taxi in front of dog, crouched, did not apply leash pressure, dog slowly stepped into taxi on own. Rode well. In yard, dog exited taxi, initially kept some distance until handler crouched down again, then dog approached. Dog sat under chair next to handler's, crawled forward, flinched heavily at most sounds and movements but allowed all petting, leaned in for it, allowed petting around neck under leash and mylar. Handler applied clip lead while petting. Dog took treats gently from hand. Handler moved to bench, called dog, dog came forward with wagging tail, put front paws on bench briefly, then hopped down, laid down at handler's feet, leaned against their legs, allowed more petting. Handler positioned taxi, crouched beside it, did not apply any leash pressure, spent a few moments gently coaxing dog forward, tapping inside of taxi with hand. Dog crawled into taxi on own.
